revisionDesc.change: Submit - Entered texts with various changes -- see comments.

Commit - Some good readings by P. Heilporn are mentioned in the notes but didn’t make it into the text of ed.pr. Ed. has δι’ Ἁθρῆτ(ος) in lin2, Θινηψᾶτος lin3, and δ (= 4) in lin4, which are wrong, whereas διὰ Βιήγχ(εως), Θινψανσ(νῶτος) and β (all PH), mentioned in the notes, are correct (RD and I agree). I put them into the text, with the deprecated readings shown as alternatives, but there must be a better way of indicating this. — In two cases R. Duttenhöfer believes (and I agree) that further progress is possible: lin1 Πακνυ( ) PH (with reservations), Παχνο̣ύ(βιος) RD, who observes that ο is hardly recognisable in this scribe’s -ου-; lin2 Τακνῦμις PH, Ταχνο̣ῦμις RD.
